text: Access and security - Publisher reports insecurity and persistent threats against response teams in Tshopo (Bafwasende, Kabondo and Mangobo); in Ituri a body passed a control point without control amid threats from the crowd against the staff, the Avakubi control points are out of service because of insecurity and three control points are on strike over late payment of September and October bonuses; the Butuhe control point (Nord-Kivu) remains out of service after a security incident; four control points in the Viadana health zone (Bas-Uele) are out of service because of a strike; a strike by providers at the CTE in Kasenyi over unpaid wages and 13 patients not fed in the Mandima health zone (Ituri); safe burials failed because of community or family resistance in Tshopo and Haut-Uele, and none was carried out for 3 community death alerts in Bas-Uele.
